snippet.title: 🔥 RARE UNSEEN FOOTAGE | Michael Jackson & Whitney Houston Rehearse "One Day In Your Life" (2001)
snippet.description:
Unseen rehearsal footage from 2001: Michael Jackson and Whitney Houston performing "One Day In Your Life" for the Michael Jackson 30th Anniversary Celebration at Madison Square Garden.

This planned duet never made it to the final show, but the rehearsal is pure magic. Watch as two of the greatest voices in music history come together – with their heartfelt embrace at the end that hits different knowing they both left us too soon. 💔

Shared by Michael Jackson’s former bodyguard Matt Fiddes on the 17th anniversary of MJ’s passing, this rare gem is a true treasure for every Michael Jackson and Whitney Houston fan.

(Note: Whitney Houston did perform at the first concert on September 7, delivering a powerful tribute of “Wanna Be Startin’ Somethin’” alongside Usher and Mýa.)

snippet.title: Rare Footage: Michael Jackson Memorial Service Broadcast Live in Times Square NYC | July 7, 2009
snippet.description:
On July 7, 2009 — twelve days after Michael Jackson’s sudden passing on June 25, 2009 at the age of 50 — the world came together to honor the King of Pop.

While the official public memorial service was held at the Staples Center in Los Angeles, giant screens in Times Square, New York City broadcast the emotional event live. Thousands of fans gathered in the heart of NYC to watch, sing along, and pay their respects.

Over 1.6 million fans applied for free tickets through an online lottery, with only around 17,500 selected to attend inside the Staples Center. This rare footage captures the powerful atmosphere in Times Square as millions around the world mourned together. The memorial was watched by an estimated one billion+ people globally.

Michael Jackson’s music, dance, and humanitarian spirit continue to inspire generations. Legends never die. 👑💔

Rest in Peace, King of Pop. We love you forever.

snippet.title: Jaafar Jackson Reveals Michael Jackson's Secret Manifestation Notes & Affirmations! ✨
snippet.description:
Jaafar Jackson on Michael Jackson’s Powerful Manifestation Practice

On The Kelly Clarkson Show, Jaafar Jackson shared how he gained access to Michael Jackson’s personal handwritten notes while preparing for the biopic Michael.

Michael was deeply dedicated to positive affirmations and manifestation. He would write inspiring messages such as:

• “I am Beautiful… I am Gorgeous”
• “I AM A MAGNET FOR MIRACLES”

He placed these notes on his mirrors and ceiling, repeated them daily, and meditated on them for 30 minutes — a powerful daily ritual that supported his incredible journey to greatness.

Jaafar was inspired by this and applied the same focused mindset and work ethic during his own preparation for the role. This dedication helped bring Michael’s spirit to life on screen in a truly special way.

A beautiful glimpse into the King of Pop’s winning mentality that continues to inspire millions.

snippet.title: Tower Records Shibuya Celebrates Michael Jackson Biopic with 1996 Handprints & Full Catalog Display
snippet.description:
Tower Records Shibuya is going all out to celebrate the Michael Jackson Biopic! 🇯🇵👑

On the 7th Floor, fans can see Michael Jackson’s original handprints and signature cast in bronze — created live during his in-store event on December 12, 1996. This historic piece remains a permanent pilgrimage spot for MJ fans worldwide.

The 6th Floor Record section is fully dedicated to Michael — showcasing his complete catalog from Jackson 5 era to solo masterpieces with vinyls, CDs, posters, and special biopic panels.

Special Events at Tower Records Shibuya:
• June 14, 2026 – Michael Jackson Tribute DJ Party
• June 25, 2026 (MJ’s Death Anniversary) – Special Memorial Event

This campaign highlights Japan’s massive and everlasting love for the King of Pop, perfectly timed with the Michael movie’s Japan release.

Michael’s legacy continues to inspire fans around the world! ✨

snippet.title: Rare BTS: Michael Jackson Checks Safety on Black or White Set – MTV 10th Anniversary 1991 👑
snippet.description:
This rare archival footage is from Michael Jackson’s rehearsals for the MTV 10th Anniversary Special held on November 14, 1991. You’ll see the King of Pop overseeing the pyrotechnics (fire effects) test on the iconic graffiti-style car used in the famous “Panther Dance” segment of Black or White.

After suffering a serious burn injury during the 1984 Pepsi commercial shoot, Michael became extremely cautious with stage effects. In this clip, he stands watching the test himself and says:

“I was burned because of this kind of stuff.”

His beloved chimpanzee Bubbles also appears on set during these historic rehearsals 🐒..
